title: crepis viscidula subsp. geracioides
intro: Crepis viscidula subsp. geracioides, commonly known as Canary Islands Hawk's Beard, is a plant species found in the Canary Islands. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it has been used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Crepis viscidula subsp. geracioides include its potential anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce pain, and exhibit anti-cancer properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
